contexts.text: The light of life is the Divine wisdom which is from the Lord alone.
The Divine intelligence and wisdom from the Lord is there presented as light. References.
His eyes redder than wine = the Divine wisdom.
Under Divine Truth, see these references. AE 726:3.
Glory = the Divine wisdom and intelligence which is of the Divine truth from the Lord.

The Lord is called the Word, because the Word = the Divine truth, or the Divine wisdom, and the Lord is the Divine truth itself, or the Divine wisdom itself... As the Divine wisdom and the Divine love make one, and in the Lord have been one from eternity, it is said, in him was life, and the life was the light of men: the life = the Divine love; and the light = the Divine wisdom.

As the Word is the Divine wisdom of the Divine love, it follows that it is Jehovah Himself, thus the Lord, by whom all things have been made that are made; for all things have been created from the Divine love through the Divine wisdom.
After His Glorification... the Lord was the Divine wisdom itself and the Divine Truth, thus the Holy Spirit.
The Holy Spirit, in special, = the Lord as to the Divine wisdom, and thence as to the Divine Truth.
That is called the Spiritual which proceeds from His Divine wisdom, and it is the Divine truth.
The light of Heaven is the Divine wisdom, which before their eyes is light.
That any predestination except to Heaven is contrary to the Divine wisdom, which is infinite.
His eyes were as a flame of fire = the Divine wisdom of the Divine love.
Full of eyes before and behind = the Divine wisdom therein.
And they were full of eyes within = the Divine wisdom in the Word in the natural sense from its spiritual and celestial sense.
Seven eyes = His omniscience, and Divine wisdom.
Having His eyes as a flame of fire = ... the Divine wisdom and intelligence communicated to those who are in love and thence in faith in Him.
As the Divine wisdom in itself is nothing but an end...
That the Divine wisdom in the Heavens appears before the eyes of the Angels as light. General article.

3. The Divine wisdom which appears in the Heavens as light, in its own essence is not light, but clothes itself with light, in order that it may appear before the sight also of the Angels; wisdom in its own essence is the Divine truth; and the light is its appearance and correspondence.
That the Divine wisdom is the Divine truth. General article.
2. The Divine wisdom is that which is called the Divine Providence, and also that which is called Divine order.
Redeemer. 2. 6. Jehovah God descended as to the Divine wisdom, or the Divine truth...
